title: Actual Q3 local-energy four-leg D(t) audit
question: Does replacing the global shifted total-energy weight by the positive local edge-energy weight keep the four D(t) weighted legs finite and less volume-sensitive on the actual Q3 histories?

model.history: D_sigma(t)=U(H+sigma W_L,t) A U(H+sigma W_L,t)^* - U(H,t) A U(H,t)^*
model.comparison: The local weight is tested against the full global weight; no global-K uniformity is assumed.

adversarial_review.check: The local edge weight is treated as a matrix in the full-H representation; no simultaneous diagonalization with rho is assumed.
All four left/right and D/D* legs are retained and independently reconstructed by trace identities.
The three graph volumes and two cutoffs are finite diagnostics only; no local-weight uniform theorem is inferred.
The full weight is a baseline for the same rows, not an admissible uniform local estimate after EXP-001146.
Common-core modular transfer, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the finite scalar four-leg identity and exact local/global fixture arithmetic; Python checks actual Q3 matrices.

qft_interface.closed: The actual Q3 D(t) four-leg quantities are evaluated with a noncommuting local edge weight and independently reconstructed by trace formulas.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform local-weight bound, modular-domain transfer, direct Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

no_overclaim: Finite actual-Q3 local-weight rows and their trace reconstruction do not prove a common-core local-energy estimate or QFT dynamics. They only test the surviving topology selected after the global-K route-local obstruction.
